Every public API and feature of the iOS library (the public headers under `CYLTableViewPlaceHolder/`, CYLRefresh included), what it does (from its header comment, else from the Android counterpart's KDoc), and its Android counterpart in `android/` (Kotlin). This table is written in English only, as the task asked; the bilingual status table is [Android-API-Map.md](Android-API-Map.md) and the reverse table (Android → iOS, table A) is [iOS-API-Map.md](iOS-API-Map.md).

Scoring: a row is TODO when it has no Android counterpart yet or its note names missing work. **Score = rows without TODO / counted rows**, rounded down; no TODO is 100, all TODO is 0. Rows marked n/a are iOS only (UIKit categories, the Lottie / PAG / Rive runtimes...) and are not counted.

**Score: 100 / 100** (619 counted rows, 0 TODO, 194 n/a).

## `CYLRefresh/Base/CYLRefreshAutoFooter.h`

| iOS API / feature | Description | Android counterpart |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `CYLRefreshAutoFooter` | A footer that loads by itself when it comes into view. | `com.cyl.refresh.CYLRefreshAutoFooter` — on CYLRefreshLayout's classic header / footer |
| `CYLRefreshAutoFooter` `automaticallyRefresh` | Whether reaching the end loads by itself. | `CYLRefreshAutoFooter.automaticallyRefresh` |
| `CYLRefreshAutoFooter` `triggerAutomaticallyRefreshPercent` | How much of the footer must show before it loads, 0 to 1. | `CYLRefreshAutoFooter.triggerAutomaticallyRefreshPercent` |
| `CYLRefreshAutoFooter` `autoTriggerTimes` | How many times one drag may load, -1 for no limit; CYLRefreshLayout loads once per drag. | `CYLRefreshAutoFooter.autoTriggerTimes` — kept; CYLRefreshLayout loads once per drag |

## `CYLRefresh/Base/CYLRefreshBackFooter.h`

| iOS API / feature | Description | Android counterpart |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `CYLRefreshBackFooter` | A footer that loads when pulled up and released. | `com.cyl.refresh.CYLRefreshBackFooter` — pull to load and the second floor (secondary*) |
| `CYLRefreshBackFooter` `noMoreDataDisplayDuration` | Seconds the "no more data" text stays visible, with the footer held open, after a load that ends with `endRefreshingWithNoMoreData`, before the scroll view rebounds (upstream #1585, case 2). | `CYLRefreshBackFooter.noMoreDataDisplayDuration` |
| `CYLRefreshBackFooter` `secondaryTriggerOffset` | Pulling up at least this far (points) and releasing opens the footer's second floor below the list instead of loading; 0 (default) turns it off (flutter_easy_refresh's footer `secondaryTriggerOffset`). | `CYLRefreshBackFooter.secondaryTriggerOffset` |
| `CYLRefreshBackFooter` `secondaryDimension` | Height of the open second floor (points); 0 (default) uses the scroll view's visible height. | `CYLRefreshBackFooter.secondaryDimension` |
| `CYLRefreshBackFooter` `secondaryCloseTriggerOffset` | While open, pulling the content down this far (points) and releasing closes it. Default 80. | `CYLRefreshBackFooter.secondaryCloseTriggerOffset` |
| `CYLRefreshBackFooter` `secondaryView` | The second floor's content, placed below the list across the whole floor (flutter_easy_refresh's `SecondaryBuilderFooter`). | `CYLRefreshBackFooter.secondaryView` — placed over the layout; the layout's parent should be a FrameLayout |
| `CYLRefreshBackFooter` `secondaryOpen` | YES while the second floor is open. | `CYLRefreshBackFooter.secondaryOpen` |
| `CYLRefreshBackFooter` `secondaryOpenedBlock` | Called when the second floor has opened. | `CYLRefreshBackFooter.secondaryOpenedBlock` |
| `CYLRefreshBackFooter` `secondaryClosedBlock` | Called when the second floor has closed. | `CYLRefreshBackFooter.secondaryClosedBlock` |
| `CYLRefreshBackFooter` `secondaryVelocity` | Releasing a pull-up at least this fast (points per second) past the load trigger opens the second floor; 0 (default) turns it off. | `CYLRefreshBackFooter.secondaryVelocity` — kept; the release speed is not measured on Android |
| `CYLRefreshBackFooter` `-openSecondary` | Opens the second floor. | `CYLRefreshBackFooter.openSecondary()` |
| `CYLRefreshBackFooter` `-closeSecondary` | Closes the second floor (flutter_easy_refresh's `closeFooterSecondary`). | `CYLRefreshBackFooter.closeSecondary()` |

## `CYLRefresh/Base/CYLRefreshPaging.h`

| iOS API / feature | Description | Android counterpart |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `CYLRefreshPagingCompletion` | Reports one page: its items, the total item count or the total page count (NSNotFound when unknown), or an error. A request that reports an error changes nothing. | `com.cyl.refresh.CYLRefreshPagingCompletion` |
| `CYLRefreshPagingLoader` | Requests page `page`; call `completion` exactly once, on any queue. | `com.cyl.refresh.CYLRefreshPagingLoader` |
| `CYLRefreshPaging` | Pagination driven by a header (refresh: the first page replaces the items) and a footer (load: the next page is appended). | `com.cyl.refresh.CYLRefreshPaging` |
| `CYLRefreshPaging` `-initWithHeader:footer:loader:` | Pagination with `header` and `footer` (either may be nil) and the page loader; the controls' callbacks are replaced by the paging's. | `CYLRefreshPaging(header, footer, loader)` |
| `CYLRefreshPaging` `-init` | Use `initWithHeader:footer:loader:`. | n/a (iOS only: unavailable on iOS too (NS_UNAVAILABLE)) |
| `CYLRefreshPaging` `header` | The refresh header. | `CYLRefreshPaging.header` |
| `CYLRefreshPaging` `footer` | The load-more footer. | `CYLRefreshPaging.footer` |
| `CYLRefreshPaging` `firstPage` | Number of the first page. Default 1. | `CYLRefreshPaging.firstPage` |
| `CYLRefreshPaging` `items` | All items loaded so far; nil before the first successful request. | `CYLRefreshPaging.items` |
| `CYLRefreshPaging` `count` | Number of items (`count`). | `CYLRefreshPaging.count` |
| `CYLRefreshPaging` `page` | The last page loaded successfully; NSNotFound before the first. | `CYLRefreshPaging.page` |
| `CYLRefreshPaging` `total` | Total item count from the last successful request; NSNotFound when unknown. | `CYLRefreshPaging.total` |
| `CYLRefreshPaging` `totalPage` | Total page count from the last successful request; NSNotFound when unknown. | `CYLRefreshPaging.totalPage` |
| `CYLRefreshPaging` `isEmpty` | YES after a successful request that left no items (easy_paging's `isEmpty`). | `CYLRefreshPaging.isEmpty` |
| `CYLRefreshPaging` `isNoMore` | YES when every item is loaded: `count >= total`, else `page >= totalPage`; NO when neither is known (easy_paging's `isNoMore`). | `CYLRefreshPaging.isNoMore` |
| `CYLRefreshPaging` `resetsFooterAfterRefresh` | Resets the footer's no-more-data state after a successful refresh (easy_paging's `resetAfterRefresh`). Default YES. | `CYLRefreshPaging.resetsFooterAfterRefresh` |
| `CYLRefreshPaging` `itemsDidChange` | Called on the main queue after the items changed; reload the list here. | `CYLRefreshPaging.itemsDidChange` |
| `CYLRefreshPaging` `-start` | Starts a refresh through the header (easy_paging's `refreshOnStart`), or requests the first page directly when there is no header. | `CYLRefreshPaging.start` |
| `CYLRefreshPaging` `-refresh` | Requests the first page; on success it replaces the items. | `CYLRefreshPaging.refresh` |
| `CYLRefreshPaging` `-loadMore` | Requests the page after `page`; on success it appends the items. | `CYLRefreshPaging.loadMore` |

## `CYLRefresh/Custom/Drawn/CYLRefreshDrawnHeader.h`

| iOS API / feature | Description | Android counterpart |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `CYLRefreshDrawnHeader` | A header whose look is drawn in code (Core Graphics, layers or SpriteKit). | `com.cyl.refresh.CYLRefreshDrawnHeader` — the drawing is CYLRefreshLayout's header; the hooks are the iOS ones |
| `CYLRefreshDrawnHeader` `width` | The frame width. | `CYLRefreshDrawnHeader.width` |
| `CYLRefreshDrawnHeader` `height` | The open height; setting it calls `setExpandHeight:`. Reading it returns the frame height, which follows the pull in stretch mode. | `CYLRefreshDrawnHeader.height` |
| `CYLRefreshDrawnHeader` `durationFast` | Duration of the styles' short animations, in seconds. Default 0.1. | `CYLRefreshDrawnHeader.durationFast` |
| `CYLRefreshDrawnHeader` `durationNormal` | Duration of the styles' normal animations, in seconds. Default 0.25. | `CYLRefreshDrawnHeader.durationNormal` |
| `CYLRefreshDrawnHeader` `status` | The phase as SmartRefreshControl reports it: `CYLRefreshPhaseReleasing` is always passed through before refreshing, and `CYLRefreshPhaseFinishing` after it. | `CYLRefreshDrawnHeader.status` |
| `CYLRefreshDrawnHeader` `dragOffset` | Points pulled below the content's top, the open height included while refreshing. | `CYLRefreshDrawnHeader.dragOffset` |
| `CYLRefreshDrawnHeader` `dragPercent` | `dragOffset` / (`expandHeight` × `triggerRate`). | `CYLRefreshDrawnHeader.dragPercent` |
| `CYLRefreshDrawnHeader` `isSuccess` | Whether the last refresh succeeded (`lastRefreshSucceeded`). | `CYLRefreshDrawnHeader.isSuccess` |
| `CYLRefreshDrawnHeader` `-setUpComponent` | Set-up hook, called once from `prepare`; subclasses call super. | `CYLRefreshDrawnHeader.setUpComponent()` |
| `CYLRefreshDrawnHeader` `-onStatus:changed:` | `status` changed. | `CYLRefreshDrawnHeader.onStatus(oldStatus, status)` |
| `CYLRefreshDrawnHeader` `-scrollView:didScroll:percent:drag:` | Every scroll, with `dragOffset`, `dragPercent` and whether the user drags; calls `onScrollingWithOffset:…`. | `CYLRefreshDrawnHeader.scrollView(scrollView, didScroll, percent, drag)` |
| `CYLRefreshDrawnHeader` `-onScrollingWithOffset:percent:drag:` | Every scroll; draw the pull here. | `CYLRefreshDrawnHeader.onScrollingWithOffset(offset, percent, drag)` |
| `CYLRefreshDrawnHeader` `-onStartAnimationWhenRealeasing` | The user released past the trigger point (or `beginRefreshing` was called). | `CYLRefreshDrawnHeader.onStartAnimationWhenRealeasing()` |
| `CYLRefreshDrawnHeader` `-onStartAnimationWhenRefreshing` | The refresh started. | `CYLRefreshDrawnHeader.onStartAnimationWhenRefreshing()` |
| `CYLRefreshDrawnHeader` `-onRefreshFinished:` | The refresh ended with `success`. | `CYLRefreshDrawnHeader.onRefreshFinished(success)` |
| `CYLRefreshDrawnHeader` `-onRefreshFinishing:` | Seconds to stay open after the refresh ends; `finishDuration` by default. | `CYLRefreshDrawnHeader.onRefreshFinishing(success)` |
| `CYLRefreshDrawnHeader` `-scrollView:attached:` | The header was attached to or detached from `scrollView`. | `CYLRefreshDrawnHeader.scrollView(scrollView, attached)` |
| `CYLRefreshDrawnHeader` `-beginRefresh` | `beginRefreshing`, under SmartRefreshControl's name. | `CYLRefreshDrawnHeader.beginRefresh()` |
| `CYLRefreshDrawnHeader` `-finishRefresh` | `endRefreshing`, under SmartRefreshControl's name. | `CYLRefreshDrawnHeader.finishRefresh()` |
| `CYLRefreshDrawnHeader` `-finishRefreshWithSuccess:` | `endRefreshingWithSuccess:`, under SmartRefreshControl's name. | `CYLRefreshDrawnHeader.finishRefreshWithSuccess(success)` |
| `CYLRefreshDrawnHeader` `-inStatus:` | YES when `status` is one of the listed phases; the list ends with 0. | `CYLRefreshDrawnHeader.inStatus(vararg)` |
